fields.implementation_summary: Implemented selective instruction loading end to end. Added one sub-500-token universal session bootstrap rule and generated instruction; removed universal applyTo from ticket, commit, and spec guidance while preserving description-only generated artifacts and narrow token-efficiency globs; removed duplicated spec-system content at its canonical frontmatter rule. Added deterministic pinned-rule rendering in session-api with non-rule exclusion and explicit missing/cross-workspace failures, plus render-instructions CLI and session_runtime_render_instructions MCP surfaces with execution-level tests.
fields.title: [session-bootstrap][rules] Minimal bootstrapper + selective instruction loading
fields.validation_summary: Passing evidence recorded in test-api: exec-val-session-selective-rule-render-20260714 (129 session API/CLI/MCP tests), exec-val-rule-selective-instruction-generation-20260714 (50 rule-cli tests plus global universal-glob and representative discovery checks), and exec-val-rule-sync-targets-20260714 (status ok, no generated drift). Focused rustfmt check for session-api/session-cli/session-mcp passed.
